steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title before configuring the sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet and Add Columns control appear.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, add the CYLINDER product and choose CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant; set Quantity Requested to 10; choose Plant Name (LOC-0001) for Delivery location; click Add Columns, choose a text column, leave its name empty, save, and stop when the error message says "Column name cannot be empty".
